entries.name: Thing
entries.notes: Explicit Thing boundaries retain concrete runtime types; typed reads validate full element types and callable signatures. No implicit coercion or dynamic arithmetic.

entries.name: Bytes
entries.notes: Owned byte sequences construct from Text, snapshot and support checked indexed reads as Number. Byte mutation and numeric-width families are not supplied.

entries.name: Pointer
entries.notes: Managed typed handles share targets; reads snapshot ordinary contents. Checked mutation rejects ownership cycles, including container and callable-environment edges. No pointer arithmetic or raw-address API.

entries.name: Null
entries.notes: Null initializes an explicit absence value; typed reads preserve evaluation and type/index/key checks. Unassigned storage and the native-definition Null atom remain separate.

entries.name: List
entries.notes: Typed owned Lists construct, append, replace and read indexed values; heterogeneous construction infers Thing without coercion. Indices and complete element types are checked. Iteration/removal remain outside this API.

entries.name: Service
entries.notes: Service declarations remain structural; standalone bodies, packages and native process operations are unsupported. App-constructed Service libraries retain their workspace topology. Static inspection; witnesses not run.

entries.name: Function
entries.notes: Functions bind typed invocation verbs and private bodies. Signatures include canonical constructor identity; aliases preserve it and incompatible transfers reject. Emission uses selected builtin/logeme definitions.

entries.name: Adjective
entries.notes: Descriptors retain canonical targets through aliases and qualified imports. Source nouns bind typed formals and fixed operands to selected constructors. Replacements consume original operands; wrappers name and preserve the base result. Operands evaluate once in authored order; native moves and borrows remain checked. This is not a resource-cost certificate.

entries.name: Process
entries.notes: Ordered source operations use the shared instruction path. Provisional input labels acquire their actual Process scope before semantic use and cannot shadow enclosing Function parameters or escape into siblings. Explicit annotations preserve declared types and dependencies for native type and borrow checking. No callable outputs or closure runtime are added.

entries.name: Function
entries.notes: The canonical Function definition supplies composed signatures and Process bodies for source declarations and constructed Objects.

entries.name: Function.Return
entries.notes: Root-authored returning actions use their caller’s selected Return. Its implementation keeps lexical delegates; Function-owned Returns retain their constructor contract and reject incompatible callers. Known unconditional source-actor and transparent-Process exits terminate typed caller flow. Real Function calls, conditional and opaque bodies retain their own boundaries and native obligations.

entries.name: Retain
entries.notes: Core Retain consumes a borrowed Arc and returns another handle to the same allocation without cloning its payload. The App source wrapper delegates to core Retain without lifecycle effects; Storage.Retain remains Rc-based. Atomic ownership does not certify payload Send/Sync or destructor costs.

entries.name: Main
entries.notes: Source-defined Service/Object/Function construction descriptor used by Apps; it grants no standalone Service process role.

entries.name: Generic
entries.notes: Native source constructors accept explicit ordered parameter atoms through their declared slots. GenericTypes and Lifetimes retain their approved local native-input contract; this does not infer parameters or introduce general L generics.

entries.name: Input
entries.notes: Input metadata covers Function parameters and scoped structured Process bindings. No App process input transport is supplied.

entries.name: IO
entries.notes: Reviewed registered export namespace for dictionary language=eng key=io. Index-driven addition/rename/deletion must trigger new review.

entries.name: IO.Print
entries.notes: Print retains Render then private Write. Write obtains one stdout guard, invokes the source Lined Sender and applies shared Result.Expect with the existing failure message; bytes, formatting and LF policy remain unchanged.
entries.effect: Writes the selected typed rendering and appends LF; no L return value is declared.

entries.name: IO.Output
entries.notes: One selected std::io::stdout call. Resource identity does not establish authority or isolation.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: Obtains the standard-output handle; does not lock, write or flush.

entries.name: IO.Diagnostic
entries.notes: One selected std::io::stderr call. It supplies an alternate native writer handle without adding an input or networking API.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: Obtains the standard-error handle; does not redirect Print.

entries.name: IO.Send
entries.notes: The source Function composes a borrowed byte view with write_all. Its native operation handles short writes and Interrupted, and rejects zero progress with WriteZero; L adds no extra retry policy. A failure can follow partial output; allocation and blocking remain native obligations.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: Writes the borrowed byte view and returns std::io::Result<()>; no added LF, lock, flush or panic.

entries.name: IO.Lined
entries.notes: Targets the actual derived Sender. Its private L-authored helper selects the retained Result; base evaluation, generic arguments, result binding and helper provenance are preserved. It adds no output transaction or lifecycle operation.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: After payload success, sends LF through the same writer; returns the first error or unit success.

entries.name: IO.Flush
entries.notes: One Write::flush call. Flushing may block or fail and does not establish durable storage.
entries.evidence: static-inspection; word-library native and import witnesses
entries.effect: Requests an explicit native writer flush and returns its IO Result.

entries.name: Render / Write
entries.notes: Render, Write, Lock, byte view and line-completion source helpers remain private dependencies. Stream, Check and Slice have no compatibility aliases; public byte IO is classified separately.

entries.name: Invalid zero sentinel
entries.notes: The unnamed zero value is a compiler sentinel; it is not one of the 23 named representation tags or a public source constructor. valueTypeCount is an enum bound, not a stored value. Static inspection only.

entries.name: Map
entries.notes: Owned typed values keyed by Text bytes; insertion/replacement and checked reads preserve complete element types and deterministic byte ordering. Distinct from a vocabulary Dictionary.

entries.name: Map
entries.notes: Internal representation tag; executable source semantics are defined by the linked runtime type contract.

entries.name: Error
entries.notes: Error values can be constructed, stored, captured and placed in typed containers. App Error is optional until inspected; extracting an absent Error rejects. Direct Show remains unsupported.

entries.name: runtime-captures
entries.notes: Activation-specific environments snapshot ordinary captures and retain shared Pointer targets. Actual arguments evaluate once in caller scope before callee entry; copies retain environments until last-owner release. App-process capture transport is not inferred.

entries.name: Storage
entries.notes: Explicitly importable implementation vocabulary, not an implicit builtin or public dictionary catalog. Source compositions own typed traversal, result binding, lazy failures, release sequencing, byte appends and caller returns. Native allocation, blocking and destructor costs remain separate obligations.

entries.name: Runtime
entries.notes: Source implementation vocabulary selected through canonical dependencies; excluded from the public standard-library catalog. Runtime privately imports canonical Storage leaves and the shared Formatting implementation; native host/platform inputs and generated composition retain separate ownership.

entries.name: Formatting
entries.notes: IO and Runtime select one canonical Formatting Function. Shared bindings, control and numeric operators use Storage. Private Integer/Wide/Indexed/Unsigned preserve their nominal targets and compose through Storage.Integral without intermediate narrowing. No Numeric dictionary or implicit arithmetic vocabulary is added. Formatting and IO do not source-load process supervision.
